comparison.objective: Unlatch an RJ45 plug in a crowded panel and relocate it to another port while leaving neighboring cables connected; candidate rejects open cartons from a moving belt.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual clip depression, constrained withdrawal, cable-obstruction management, precision insertion and latch re-engagement versus conveyor tracking, flap avoidance, sidewall support and level content-preserving transport.
comparison.success_condition: Requires prior clip release, source withdrawal, target seating within alignment limits, hook retention, neighbors undisturbed and 2 s released hold; candidate requires tray release with all contents retained, 3 s dwell and untouched closed-carton passage.
comparison.reason: These tasks share only generic grasp/release and collision avoidance. Connector unlatching and retained insertion are materially different from selective spill-safe conveyor rejection. The Ethernet draft has no task.json and lacks a successful full robot run, but all supplied README/task.py/scoring.py versions consistently define the distinct ability.
